in_marathi.name: Parthavi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Maiden of the heavens
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parthavi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess Parvati, the divine consort of Lord Shiva. The name Parthavi comes from Parvatam, which means 'mountain' in Sanskrit. Parvati is the goddess of fertility, love, and relationships. She is also known as the giver of life, and her name is believed to bring prosperity and happiness.
